parts:
How do I know if you don't show me the function Corpus and VectorSource? Self contained test cases please! 
This is something that works and is similar, maybe it's going to give the right idea. I started form the mtcars dataset since you have it, pretending the car names are a corpus and the gear number an index. Not very realistic but just for the sake of this example.

from.dfs(mapreduce(to.dfs(mtcars), map = function(k,v) keyval(v$gear, row.names(v)), reduce = function(k,vv) keyval(k,list(vv))))

Output

$key
[1] 3 4 5

$val
$val[[1]]
 [1] "Hornet 4 Drive"      "Hornet Sportabout"   "Valiant"             "Duster 360"          "Merc 450SE"          "Merc 450SL"          "Merc 450SLC"         "Cadillac Fleetwood" 
 [9] "Lincoln Continental" "Chrysler Imperial"   "Toyota Corona"       "Dodge Challenger"    "AMC Javelin"         "Camaro Z28"          "Pontiac Firebird"   

$val[[2]]
 [1] "Mazda RX4"      "Mazda RX4 Wag"  "Datsun 710"     "Merc 240D"      "Merc 230"       "Merc 280"       "Merc 280C"      "Fiat 128"       "Honda Civic"    "Toyota Corolla"
[11] "Fiat X1-9"      "Volvo 142E"    

$val[[3]]

Please use the keys and values function when accessing the elements of a keyval pair.
I hope this helps
